title.narrative: RESILIENCE: Civil society action to reaffirm media freedom and counter disinformation and hateful propaganda in the Western Balkans and Turkey

description.narrative: The action's primary focus is on strengthening capacities of media CSOs and grassroot organisations through networking and cooperation at regional level to improve understanding of disinformation and hateful propaganda models of media and communication in the Western Balkans and Turkey, and their ability to respond and debunk fake news, particularly online, and to build resilience of citizens against disinformation and promote solutions jointly with media professionals and other stakeholders.
